payload.title: Separate Frank self-hosted execution authority from receipt-write authority
payload.work_clay: design and test a least-authority Hostinger Actions topology in which build/test/model execution has read-only repository authority and emits bounded receipts, while a separate constrained persistence/adjudication path verifies and writes admitted evidence; evaluate ephemeral or JIT runner lifecycle for higher-authority jobs without breaking reproducibility
payload.reason_clay: current persistent self-hosted workflow requests contents write and persists checkout credentials in the same executor that runs build/test code; GitHub documents that self-hosted runners need not start clean per job and recommends ephemeral runners for clean-job isolation in autoscaling scenarios; no compromise is claimed
payload.completion_clay: one end-to-end proof shows read-only self-hosted execution, successful bounded receipt transport, separate constrained repository persistence, no secret/raw-environment persistence, and no regression in current 21-gate reproducibility; alternative ephemeral/JIT feasibility is documented with evidence or explicit NOT_SELECTED outcome
evidence_need: negative controls for unadmitted write attempts
payload.executor_policy: security hardening must preserve the current evidence pipeline; do not claim compromise; prefer minimal privilege and clean-job isolation where operationally justified; test before changing production workflow authority
dependencies: current Hostinger runner remains a research/test lane
invalidators: runner lifecycle changes to already-clean ephemeral execution
separate writer would weaken evidence authenticity or make receipts unverifiable
